"""Camera-guided controller for VLABench select_mahjong, one episode."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def snapshot(robot, name, depth=True):
    res = robot.get_obs(include_depth=depth, video='none')
    res.save(OUT / name)
    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':
    robot = Robot()
    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(robot.spec(), indent=2))
    obs = snapshot(robot, 'initial')
    print(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r = Robot()
        self.spec = self.r.spec()
        initial = self.r.get_obs(cameras=['forward'], video='none')
        self.now = np.array(initial.meta['proprio']['now'])
        self.limits = np.array(self.spec['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
        observed = np.eye(4)
        observed[:3, 3] = self.now[16:19]
        observed[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_quat(self.now[19:23], scalar_first=True).as_matrix()
        self.calibration = observed @ np.linalg.inv(self.fk(self.now[:7], calibrated=False))
        self.log = OUT / 'commands.jsonl'

    def fk(self, q, calibrated=True):
        a = [0, 0, 0, .0825, -.0825, 0, .088]
        d = [.333, 0, .316, 0, .384, 0, 0]
        alpha = [0, -np.pi/2, np.pi/2, np.pi/2, -np.pi/2, np.pi/2, np.pi/2]
        t = np.eye(4)
        t[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_euler('z', np.pi/2).as_matrix()
        t[:3, 3] = [0, -.4, .78]
        for ai, di, al, qi in zip(a, d, alpha, q):
            x = np.eye(4)
            x[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_euler('x', al).as_matrix()
            x[0, 3] = ai
            z = np.eye(4)
            z[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_euler('z', qi).as_matrix()
            z[2, 3] = di
            t = t @ x @ z
        hand = np.eye(4)
        hand[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_euler('z', -np.pi/4).as_matrix()
        hand[2, 3] = .2
        t = t @ hand
        return self.calibration @ t if calibrated else t

    def ik(self, xyz, rot, seed=None):
        seed = self.now[:7] if seed is None else np.asarray(seed)
        xyz = np.array(xyz)
        def residual(q):
            t = self.fk(q)
            return np.r_[5*(t[:3,3]-xyz), Rotation.from_matrix(rot @ t[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec(), .008*(q-seed)]
        sol = least_squares(residual, seed, bounds=(self.limits[:,0]+.002,self.limits[:,1]-.002), max_nfev=250, xtol=1e-10, ftol=1e-10, gtol=1e-10)
        t = self.fk(sol.x)
        pe = np.linalg.norm(t[:3,3]-xyz)
        re = np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(rot@t[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec())
        if pe>.004 or re>.03: raise ValueError(f'IK inaccurate: position {pe}, rotation {re}')
        return sol.x

    def move(self, xyz, rot=None, finger=.04, seconds=3, name='move'):
        if rot is None: rot = np.diag([1,-1,-1])
        q = self.ik(xyz, rot)
        return self.joints(q, finger, seconds, name)

    def joints(self, q, finger=.04, seconds=3, name='joints'):
        target = np.r_[q, finger, finger]
        start = self.now[23:32]
        n = int(round(seconds/.1))
        blend = np.linspace(0, 1, n)
        blend = blend*blend*(3-2*blend)
        actions = start + blend[:,None]*(target-start)
        with self.log.open('a') as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'actions':actions.tolist(),'dt':.1})+'\n')
        res = self.r.submit('joint_position', actions, dt=.1, cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'], video='none', include_depth=True, note=name)
        res.save(OUT/name)
        self.now = np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'])
        print(name, 'tcp=',self.now[16:23], 'fingers=', self.now[14:16], 'meta=', {k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ['control_steps','done','reason','time_left_s']}, flush=True)
        return res

    def hold(self, seconds=1, name='hold'):
        res=self.r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, include_depth=True, video='none')
        res.save(OUT/name)
        self.now=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'])
        print(name, 'tcp=',self.now[16:23], 'fingers=', self.now[14:16], 'meta=', {k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ['control_steps','done','reason','time_left_s']}, flush=True)
        return res

from pathlib import Path
import json
out=Path('/app/output')
records=[json.loads(s) for s in (out/'commands.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
plan=[]
for record in records:
    if record['name']=='release_tile': break
    plan.append(dict(kind='submit', **record))
    if record['name']=='approach_tile': plan.append(dict(kind='hold',seconds=.7,name='approach_settle'))
    if record['name']=='close_gripper': plan.append(dict(kind='hold',seconds=1.,name='grasp_settle'))
(out/'trajectory.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan))
p=out/'gen.py';s=p.read_text()
start=s.index("if __name__ == '__main__':")
end=s.index('from scipy.spatial.transform',start)
s=s[:start]+s[end:]
s += '''\n\ndef replay():
    """Replay our camera-guided commands, preserving all settling intervals.

    The tile was identified from its six green bamboo marks in the forward
    camera. Calibrated Panda kinematics generated the recorded joint targets.
    The service stops execution as soon as placement succeeds.
    """
    robot = Robot()
    for action in json.loads((OUT / 'trajectory.json').read_text()):
        if robot.status()['done']:
            break
        if action['kind'] == 'hold':
            res = robot.get_obs(seconds=action['seconds'], cameras=['forward'], video='none')
        else:
            res = robot.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(action['actions'], dtype=np.float64),
                               dt=action['dt'], interpolate='linear', cameras=['forward'],
                               video='none', note=action['name'])
        print(action['name'], res.meta.get('control_steps'), res.meta.get('reason'), flush=True)
        if res.done:
            break
    status = robot.status()
    (OUT / 'final_status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    replay()
'''
p.write_text(s)
